responsibility: Declares the Rust frontend’s internal type system used by HIR type checking. It defines the TypeKind taxonomy, the BaseType abstraction with bound and substitution-related hooks, and the concrete TyTy classes for primitive types, ADTs, tuples, functions, references, pointers, arrays, generic params, placeholders, projections, trait objects, closures, and related operations that later passes use for unification, coercion, substitution, and method or trait resolution.
same_name_distinction: Declares the TyTy type-system API and class layout that rust-tyty.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, this header is the interface shared with the rest of gcc/rust/typecheck: it introduces the TypeKind enum, BaseType contract, and the concrete TyTy class declarations, method signatures, and data members without the implementation bodies.
